data.loss: assistant tokens only: each assistant turn's text and its end-of-turn marker (chat), or the response and EOS (alpaca)
data.packing: concatenated examples separated by EOS; attention is not isolated between examples

provenance.int4_attention_linears: engines.int4_attn.attention_linears (the serving swap's rule) on the meta tree
provenance.kv: serve_paged._kv_geometry + paged_runner.kv_layers over decoder_layers (the paged server's rules)
provenance.paged_state_refusal: engines.paged_runner.paged_state_refusal (the runner's own rules) on the meta tree
provenance.structure: module tree built on meta from the config (no weights read)
provenance.tied_embeddings: config tie_word_embeddings (the loader's rule when no lm_head.weight ships)
provenance.vocab_size: lm_head.out_features on the meta tree (the width the chunked loss's gate reads)

model.summary: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B (qwen3_moe, qwen2_moe): 48/48 MoE layers, E=128 H=2048 I=768, top-8; 28.99B expert + 1.54B dense params

note: Rebuild the base model with this setup and revision, then load these adapter tensors. An unpinned base revision is not reproducible; local base snapshots must remain available.
